a1273.reason: The body claimed McCartney's 'own account' and his sheepdog Martha as the reason for the Sgt. Pepper dog tone; neither is documented. The documented account is George Martin's ('Paul had said … Let's put on something which only a dog can hear'), while MacDonald/Wikipedia credit Lennon. Body now cites Martin's account and the Lennon alternative; notes accept John Lennon.
